text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer hadn't shown up
even though it was time for training,
so when I went to look for her—

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
—Wow, awesome!
Big sis, you're a master hole-digger!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, pretty amazing, right? Pretty amazing, right?
Let's connect this tunnel here too, then~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, Trainer.
This kid said they were bored playing alone,
so we were just building a tunnel together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're here, what do you say?
Wanna join in, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, sorry! I completely forgot!
What in the world was I doing...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While praising her kindness in playing with the children,
I gently reminded her that forgetting her schedule wasn't good.
